turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Lim from the anesthesia team. Today, we'll discuss your upcoming TURP surgery and the anesthesia plan. Can you please share how your prostate issues have been affecting you?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, yes. Been having trouble for about a year now. Weak stream, waking up multiple times at night to pee... it's quite tiring, you know?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: I see. Let's go through your medications. You're on amlodipine, lisinopril, atorvastatin, metformin, omeprazole, and aspirin. Have you stopped or changed any medications in the past year, especially those related to cardiovascular or antiplatelet therapy?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Oh, the aspirin one. I stopped that six months ago because it kept giving me stomach discomfort, like burning sensation. Doctor said okay to stop since my BP and sugar are controlled.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for clarifying that. So, your current medications are all still active? Amlodipine, lisinopril, atorvastatin, metformin, and omeprazole?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, all still taking them. No issues with those, just the aspirin was the problem.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Any known allergies to medications or other substances?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: None that I know of, doctor.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. When was your last meal or drink? We need to ensure you're NPO for surgery.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Had dinner at 8pm last night. Only water after that, stopped at 10pm.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Have you had any previous anesthesia or surgeries? Any problems like nausea, breathing issues, or reactions?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No surgeries before this. Never been under GA, so no issues to report.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Lastly, how's your mobility? Can you walk, climb stairs, or do you need assistance?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I can walk on my own, but sometimes need to rush to the toilet. Stairs are a bit slow, but manageable.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. We'll proceed with general anesthesia and in-line stabilization as planned. You'll be monitored closely for blood pressure and sugar levels during surgery.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Alright, thank you, doctor. Hope everything goes smoothly.
